summary:
Verified enriched Admin Dashboard end-to-end. Backend GET /api/admin/stats with admin token returns 200 with ALL required keys (total_users, premium_users, total_songs, total_albums, total_plays, total_playlists, total_radio, total_churches, total_neno, total_plans, total_transactions, guest_plays, logged_plays, revenue, currency, top_songs[], recent_transactions[]); real values observed (44 users, 17 premium, 36 songs, 8 albums, 60 plays, 5 playlists, 4 radio, 4 neno, 3 churches, 3 plans, 16 txns, revenue 8,000 TZS, guest 46 vs logged 14). No-token -> 401, non-admin token -> 403. Admin login works with 'Vibe@2026' and empty password (role=admin, /api/auth/me confirms). Admin CRUD regression: GET /api/admin/users list, POST /api/admin/albums, POST /api/admin/songs all succeed for admin; POST /api/admin/albums returns 403 for normal user. 10/10 pytest passing.

Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): guest /admin gate shows testID='admin-login' -> /(auth)/login navigation confirmed. After admin login, /admin Overview renders all 12 stat cards with numeric values (stat-users..stat-revenue). 'Uchambuzi wa Michezo' shows logged vs guest counts (14 / 46) with the proportional bar. 'Nyimbo Zinazoongoza' lists top songs with plays. 'Malipo ya Karibuni' section renders. Content tab exposes admin-add-album & admin-add-song plus the 8-album list. Users tab shows the full 44-user list including admin@vibe.app. No crashes switching tabs; no red screen.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py /stats now aggregates 13 counts + revenue + top_songs + recent_transactions with proper _id exclusion. Consider parallelising the count_documents calls with asyncio.gather for lower latency as the dashboard grows.

admin/index.tsx uses value={stats.revenue?.toLocaleString()} — will render 'undefined' as text if revenue is 0 due to falsy-ish chain when revenue is undefined; currently backend always returns integer so OK, but a defensive Number(stats.revenue||0).toLocaleString() would be safer.
recent_transactions map uses index as key which is fine given small list; showing plan_id string as title works but a resolved plan name (join with subscription_plans) would be nicer UX.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ users + a TEST album/song created and cleaned up inside the pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin stats endpoint returns full enriched payload; frontend Overview populates 12 stat cards + plays breakdown + top songs + recent payments. Login flow via /(auth)/login uses inputs[0]=email, inputs[1]=password and 'Ingia' text button (no dedicated submit testID). Backend admin CRUD (albums/songs/users/plans) unchanged and passing.
